name: Garbage Truck
summary: Green garbage truck with a big rear compactor body and a bin lift arm, side view facing right; for street scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: floor line: the wheels stand on y

params.name: s
params.note: room scale: about 880 px wide and 470 px tall at s = 1; use about 0.8 for a smaller scene

params.name: anim
params.note: drive = wheels spin and the body bounces (also on when vx is not 0)

params.name: vx
params.note: horizontal speed in px per frame (negative = left; set flip too)

params.name: flip
params.note: mirror so the cab faces left

author: krakujs
